title: Antitumor Activity of Nitazoxanide against Colon Cancers: Molecular Docking and Experimental Studies Based on Wnt/beta-Catenin Signaling Inhibition.
authors: Abd El-Fadeal, Noha M; Nafie, Mohamed S; K El-Kherbetawy, Mohammed; El-Mistekawy, Amr; Mohammad, Hala M F; Elbahaie, Alaaeldeen M; Hashish, Abdullah A; Alomar, Suliman Y; Aloyouni, Sheka Yagub; El-Dosoky, Mohamed; Morsy, Khaled M; Zaitone, Sawsan A
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和实验探讨硝唑尼特对结肠癌Wnt/β-catenin信号通路的抑制作用，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物抗肿瘤活性，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: In colon cancer, wingless (Wnt)/beta-catenin signaling is frequently upregulated; however, the creation of a molecular therapeutic agent targeting this pathway is still under investigation. This research aimed to study how nitazoxanide can affect Wnt/beta-catenin signaling in colon cancer cells (HCT-116) and a mouse colon cancer model. Our study included 2 experiments; the first was to test the cytotoxic activity of nitazoxanide in an in vitro study on a colon cancer cell line (HCT-116) versus normal colon cells (FHC) and to highlight the proapoptotic effect by MTT assay, flow cytometry and real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR). The second experiment tested the in vivo cytotoxic effect of nitazoxanide against 1,2-dimethylhydrazine (DMH) prompted cancer in mice. Mice were grouped as saline, DMH control and DMH + nitazoxanide [100 or 200 mg per kg]. Colon levels of Wnt and beta-catenin proteins were assessed by Western blotting while proliferation was measured via immunostaining for proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA). Treating HCT-116 cells with nitazoxanide (inhibitory concentration 50 (IC50) = 11.07 microM) revealed that it has a more cytotoxic effect when compared to 5-flurouracil (IC50 = 11.36 microM). Moreover, it showed relatively high IC50 value (non-cytotoxic) against the normal colon cells. Nitazoxanide induced apoptosis by 15.86-fold compared to control and arrested the cell cycle. Furthermore, nitazoxanide upregulated proapoptotic proteins (P53 and BAX) and caspases but downregulated BCL-2. Nitazoxanide downregulated Wnt/beta-catenin/glycogen synthase kinase-3beta (GSK-3beta) signaling and PCNA staining in the current mouse model. Hence, our findings highlighted the cytotoxic effect of nitazoxanide and pointed out the effect on Wnt/beta-catenin/GSK-3beta signaling.
abstract_zh: 在结肠癌中，无翅（Wnt）/β-连环蛋白信号通路经常上调；然而，针对该通路的分子治疗药物的研发仍在探索中。本研究旨在探讨硝唑尼特如何影响结肠癌细胞（HCT-116）和小鼠结肠癌模型中的Wnt/β-连环蛋白信号通路。我们的研究包括两个实验：第一个实验是在体外研究中测试硝唑尼特对结肠癌细胞系（HCT-116）与正常结肠细胞（FHC）的细胞毒性活性，并通过MTT法、流式细胞术和实时聚合酶链反应（RT-PCR）突出其促凋亡效应。第二个实验测试了硝唑尼特对1,2-二甲基肼（DMH）诱导的小鼠癌症的体内细胞毒性效应。小鼠被分为盐水组、DMH对照组和DMH+硝唑尼特[100或200毫克/千克]组。通过Western blotting评估结肠中Wnt和β-连环蛋白蛋白水平，而增殖则通过增殖细胞核抗原（PCNA）的免疫染色进行测量。用硝唑尼特处理HCT-116细胞（半数抑制浓度（IC50）= 11.07微摩尔）显示，与5-氟尿嘧啶（IC50 = 11.36微摩尔）相比，其具有更强的细胞毒性效应。此外，它对正常结肠细胞显示出相对较高的IC50值（非细胞毒性）。硝唑尼特诱导凋亡，与对照组相比增加了15.86倍，并使细胞周期停滞。此外，硝唑尼特上调了促凋亡蛋白（P53和BAX）和半胱天冬酶，但下调了BCL-2。在当前小鼠模型中，硝唑尼特下调了Wnt/β-连环蛋白/糖原合成酶激酶-3β（GSK-3β）信号通路和PCNA染色。因此，我们的发现强调了硝唑尼特的细胞毒性效应，并指出了其对Wnt/β-连环蛋白/GSK-3β信号通路的影响。
